expected_structural_delta: Three settings, two helpers, six existing GitHub lifecycle boundaries and unsupported GitLab preflight rejection. Focused tests plus existing check.sh/config form/docs. No module/process/timer/journal/store/dependency. No future-write reservation, drain, quota change or active-job stop.
minimum_design: Extend existing GitHub owner boundaries with strict opt-in policy validation and bounded actual DockerRootDir plus workspace byte/inode observations. Check before pulls, creates, starts and old-owner retirement; preserve cleanup and read-only commands.
outcome: Opted-in GitHub runner creation, restart, replacement and image preparation withhold work below explicit known storage floors, including minimum refills, while cleanup and existing jobs continue.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing serialized provider lifecycle
reuse_decisions.rationale: Owns start, restart, pull, replacement and validation; no second controller or reservation owner.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing cache cleanup
reuse_decisions.rationale: Remain independently operable with existing ownership fences; cleanup percentage is not start policy.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing config and logs
reuse_decisions.rationale: Three default-disabled engine settings and existing errors; no new durable status store.
